title: Dollar stablecoin policy transmission
purpose: Investigate whether expanding US support for dollar stablecoins creates overlooked effects in issuance, reserves, payments and market liquidity.

readyWork.summary: Investigate whether expanding US support for dollar stablecoins creates overlooked effects in issuance, reserves, payments and market liquidity.
deliverables: Source readiness inventory with provenance, availability, cost and gaps
At most three distinct mechanisms and one preregisterable experiment or blocker
Evidence-linked candidate result and handoff within the experiment budget
acceptanceCriteria: Verify the policy premise with dated primary sources; separate private issuance, policy, Treasury backing and tokenized Treasuries; audit redemption and reserve publication clocks.
Use existing data only; do not open sealed outcomes
Record biases and remain DATA_FEASIBILITY or DATA_BLOCKED; no predictive promotion
Compare overlapping prior candidates and preserve their locked outcomes
